candidate_eos.gamma_classification: assumed provisional pressure-density exponent; not a measured value, not fitted for stability, and not Cp/Cv
candidate_eos.rho_formula: rho0*((p+B)/(p0+B))^(1/gamma); T is unused by the v2512 adiabaticPerfectFluid rho(p,T) implementation

thermo_interpretation.why_gamma_is_distinct: In captured OpenCFD v2512 source, adiabaticPerfectFluid returns zero EOS Cp/CpMCv contributions; HtoEthermo computes Cv=Cp-EOS.CpMCv. The pressure exponent gamma therefore sets the barotropic rho(p) slope independently of the hConst Cp/Cv values.

material_reference.rho0_note: Retained from the selected cold rhoConst baseline, not reset to the correlation value. The difference is explicit and contributes to the EOS mass shift.
material_reference.source_uncertainty: IAPWS reports 0.005% relative uncertainty for sound speed in the stable region, interpreted by the release as an expanded uncertainty with coverage factor k=2.

primary_source.calculation_locator: Eqs. (2)-(3), Table 1 coefficients (PDF pp. 3-4); Table 2 cp0 and vT0 derivatives (p. 5); Table 3 speed-of-sound identity (p. 6). Direct evaluation at 293.15 K, not interpolation or a new fit.
primary_source.implementation_check_locator: Table 8 (PDF p. 11): evaluating the same published equations at 298.15 K reproduces the table's 1496.69922 m/s within 2.0000066e-6 m/s.
primary_source.pressure_temperature_scope: The correlation is for 0.1 MPa and 253.15-383.15 K. Its limited pressure discussion does not validate this candidate EOS through the apparatus tank pressure (~1.21 MPa); do not claim that extrapolation is validated.
primary_source.title: IAPWS SR6-08(2011), Revised Supplementary Release on Properties of Liquid Water at 0.1 MPa
